name: Account
description: The name of the Azure Storage account to create. Must be globally unique, 3-24 characters, lowercase letters and numbers only.

name: Account name
description: The name of the App Configuration store.

name: Action
description: The action to perform. Options include: 'all' (best practices for both code generation and deployment, only for static-web-app), 'code-generation' (best practices for code generation, for general and azurefunctions), or 'deployment' (best practices for deployment, for general and azurefunctions).

name: Allow public access to blobs
description: Whether to allow public access to blobs in the storage account.

name: Command
description: The Azure CLI command to execute (without the 'az' prefix). For a complete list of Azure CLI commands, see the [Azure CLI reference documentation](/cli/azure/reference-index).

name: Command
description: The Azure Developer CLI command to execute (without the 'azd' prefix). For a complete list of Azure Developer CLI commands, see the [Azure Developer CLI reference documentation](/azure/developer/azure-developer-cli/reference).

name: Datadog resource
description: The name of the Datadog resource in Azure.

name: Default access tier for blobs
description: The default access tier for blob storage. Valid values: Hot, Cool.

name: Description
description: A description of the test and its purpose.

name: Display name
description: A user-friendly name for the new load test.

name: Duration
description: The total duration of the test in seconds.

name: Enable hierarchical namespace (Data Lake)
description: Whether to enable hierarchical namespace (Data Lake Storage Gen2) for the storage account.

name: Endpoint
description: The URL endpoint to test.

name: Host pool
description: The name of the Azure Virtual Desktop host pool. This is the unique name you choose for your host pool.

name: Host pool resource ID
description: The Azure resource ID of the host pool. When you provide this ID, the server uses it instead of searching by name.

name: Include service instruction templates
description: Whether to include service instruction templates in the response for deployment guidance.

name: Include stop sold plans
description: Whether to include plans that are no longer available for purchase in the results.

name: Key
description: The key name of the setting to delete.

name: Key
description: The name of the key to create.

name: Key type
description: The type of key to create (RSA, EC).

name: Kind
description: The storage account kind. Valid values: Storage, StorageV2, BlobStorage, FileStorage, BlockBlobStorage.

name: Label
description: The label of the setting to delete.

name: Language
description: The language code for localized product information (for example, 'en-us', 'fr-fr').

name: License name
description: A filter to specify the license type of the models to retrieve.

name: Lookup offer in tenant level
description: Whether to look up the offer at the tenant level for organization-specific information.

name: Market
description: The market or region code to get region-specific pricing and availability (for example, 'US', 'FR').

name: Model name
description: The name of the model to search for.

name: Namespace
description: The fully qualified Service Bus namespace host name.

name: None
description: This command requires no parameters and lists all available tools.

name: Plan ID
description: The specific plan identifier within the product to get detailed plan information.

name: Pricing audience
description: The target audience for pricing information (for example, 'public', 'private', 'government').

name: Product ID
description: The unique identifier for the marketplace product you want to retrieve information about.

name: Publisher name
description: A filter to specify the publisher of the models to retrieve.

name: Queue name
description: The queue name to get details for.

name: Ramp-up time
description: The time period over which to gradually increase load to the specified number of virtual users.

name: Region
description: The Azure region where you want to create the storage account (for example, 'eastus', 'westus2').

name: Require secure transfer (HTTPS)
description: Whether to require secure transfer (HTTPS) for the storage account.

name: Resource
description: The type of Azure resource to get best practices for. Options include: 'general' (general Azure best practices), 'azurefunctions' (Azure Functions specific best practices), or 'static-web-app' (Azure Static Web Apps specific best practices).

name: Resource group
description: The name of the Azure resource group to scope the scan to a specific resource group.

name: Resource group
description: The resource group where you want to create the load test.

name: Resource group
description: The name of the Azure resource group containing the Datadog resource.

name: Resource group
description: The resource group that contains the SQL server.

name: Resource group
description: The name of the Azure resource group.

name: Resource type
description: The Azure resource type in format '{ResourceProvider}/{ResourceType}' (e.g., 'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts', 'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines')

name: Scope
description: The scope to list role assignments for. Can be a subscription, resource group, or resource.

name: Search for free playground
description: If set to true, returns a list of models from Azure AI Foundry that can also be used with GitHub inference endpoint and GitHub PAT token. If false, returns a list of models from Azure AI Foundry, regardless of GitHub support. To learn more, see [GitHub Models](https://docs.github.com/en/github-models/use-github-models/prototyping-with-ai-models#experimenting-with-ai-models-in-the-playground).

name: Server
description: The PostgreSQL server to be accessed.

name: Server name
description: The name of the SQL server to list Microsoft Entra administrators for.

name: SKU
description: The storage account SKU. Valid values: Standard_LRS, Standard_GRS, Standard_RAGRS, Standard_ZRS, Premium_LRS, Premium_ZRS, Standard_GZRS, Standard_RAGZRS.

name: SKU ID
description: The specific pricing SKU identifier for a specific product variant or configuration.

name: Subscription
description: The Azure subscription ID or name.

name: Subscription
description: The ID of the subscription containing the App Configuration store.

name: Subscription
description: The ID or name of your Azure subscription containing the AKS clusters.

name: Subscription
description: The ID of the subscription containing the Redis clusters.

name: Subscription
description: The Azure subscription ID or name to scan for compliance issues.

name: Subscription

name: Subscription
description: The ID of the subscription containing the Datadog resource.

name: Subscription
description: The ID of the Azure subscription containing the resources.

name: Subscription
description: The ID or name of your Azure subscription that contains the SQL server.

description: The Azure subscription ID or name.

name: Subscription
description: The name or ID of the user subscription.

name: Test ID
description: A unique identifier for the test.

name: Test resource name
description: The name of the test resource to use.

name: User name
description: The user name to access PostgreSQL server.

name: Vault
description: The name of the Key Vault.

name: Virtual users
description: The number of concurrent virtual users for the load test.
